visual_thesis: A vibrant celebration of Turkish culture, combining rich Ottoman gold filigree, famous Iznik ceramic tilework, and iconic symbols like the Nazar eye, Turkish tea, and fairy chimneys.
art_style: Glossy 3D casual mobile style with rich textures, polished gold highlights, and vibrant crimson and turquoise hues.

banner.text: SAVE THE KING IN ANCIENT TURKEY!

roles.concept: Iconic Turkish cultural elements and delicacies recreated as distinct, vibrant 3D mobile game icons.
roles.image_direction: Set of standalone 3D casual visual icons representing Turkish heritage, with polished glossy surfaces and rich colors, each isolated on a true transparent alpha background.
